title: Cerebus Oct #115 Jaka's Story Part Two 1988 Aardvark-Vanaheim Comics
descriptionText:
This is a rare and collectible comic book featuring the second part of Jaka's story in the Cerebus series. Published in 1988 by Aardvark-Vanaheim, this single issue comic book is written and illustrated by Dave Sim and Gerhard respectively. It belongs to the Copper Age (1984-1991) of US comics and is a vintage item for collectors.

The comic book is in English language and features the character Cerebus, aardvark-like creature who serves as the protagonist in the series. The comic book is a type of comic book and is a must-have for fans of the genre. Get your hands on this classic piece of comic book history!
